dates.text: vli decembris ano a nativitate domini millesioquadrigentesio quadragesimo quarto

data.summary: The Pope grants a dispensation to the inhabitants of Montis de Gla, exempting them from ecclesiastical citations, excommunications, and other molestations during the winter months due to the danger of travel to their parish church.
